engine: PostgreSQL 16.14, compiled by Visual C++ build 1944, 64-bit
target_engine: PostgreSQL 16 validated on isolated temporary databases
scope: Review migration/schema constraints only; application services, HTTP, storage and concurrency not implemented/tested.

cases.name: upgrade applies to existing restaurants and keeps original rows
fresh database accepts the full migration chain
one menu per restaurant
session cannot refer to another restaurant table
category from another tenant cannot receive product
variant cannot use group from another product or tenant
negative variant price
catalog identities are archived instead of deleted
invalid option group limits
settings author from other tenant
pending asset cannot be attached as cover
referenced media cannot enter deletion state
READY derivative cannot be overwritten
published revision cannot be rewritten
published media references cannot be removed
published media references cannot be added in later transaction
menu cannot point to another restaurant publication
duplicate submission key
order cannot point to another restaurant session
order item variant must belong to its product
selected option must belong to the same product as line
quantity counters must sum to ordered quantity
order financial snapshot cannot be changed
line price snapshot cannot be changed
selection snapshot cannot be changed
audit event cannot be deleted
transition requires non-null quantity
cancellation requires reason
kitchen delivery and waiter cancellation preserve partial quantities
draft edits do not change publication or order prices
deleting authors preserves tenant, events and historical labels
session closure does not delete orders
